jobs.title: Vice President of Interconnects Product Line Management
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

How You Will Contribute

We are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Vice President of Interconnects Product Line Management (PLM)
to lead global product strategy, roadmap execution, and P&L performance for our Interconnects portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Product officer, this individual plays a pivotal role in scaling the interconnects portfolio to triple the revenue in FY27 on the path to $1B
. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our high-speed optical interconnect products (400G, 800G, 1.6T, and emerging 3.2T architectures), capturing market share across hyperscale data center interconnect (DCI), AI/ML clusters, and metro/long-haul networks.

You will partner closely with R&D, supply chain, services and global sales and marketing to translate complex market inflection points into high-margin, differentiated hardware and software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the multi-year product vision, investment strategy and technology roadmap for the Interconnects business unit, establishing competitive differentiation across coherent optical transceivers (ZR/ZR+), co-packaged optics (CPO), pluggable optics, and intra-data center interconnects.
P&L Ownership & Commercial Growth: Own full P&L accountability for a three hundred-million-dollar-plus product line, driving aggressive top-line growth, gross margin expansion, and disciplined lifecycle management with a goal of tripling the revenue in FY27.
Hyperscale & Tier-1 Customer Engagement: Serve as the executive product sponsor for top-tier hyperscalers, AI infrastructure builders, and Tier-1 service providers, securing critical design wins and shaping custom ASIC/DSP and optical specifications.
Cross-Functional Execution: Lead and scale a global organization of Product Line Managers, working seamlessly with R&D, Operations, Sales and Global Supply Chain to ensure on-time NPI (New Product Introduction) delivery and high-volume manufacturing ramps.
Ecosystem & Standards Leadership: Represent the company across key industry standards bodies and MSAs (e.g., OIF, IEEE, Ethernet Alliance), influencing next-generation optical form factors and interoperability standards.
Strategic Partnerships & M&A: Identify strategic technology partnerships, ecosystem alliances, and supply chain vertical integration opportunities to accelerate time-to-market and strengthen competitive moats

What Makes You an Exceptional Candidate?

The successful candidate is a results-oriented, strategic and inspirational leader who knows how to drive performance, has a passion for the business, and a fierce competitive drive.

Executive Leadership: 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in optical networking, semiconductors, or high-speed data center infrastructure, with at least 5+ years at the VP/SVP level managing a $300M+ P&L and scaling high-growth product lines.
Deep Domain Expertise: Proven track record in optical interconnects, coherent DSPs, silicon photonics, high-speed transceivers (400G/800G/1.6T), and hyperscale AI/data center architectures.
Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success winning Tier-1 and hyperscale qualifications, navigating complex BOM cost-down curves, and scaling high-volume manufacturing ramps.
Strategic & Technical Fluency: Ability to bridge deep technical architecture discussions with C-level commercial strategy; bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Physics, or Optical Sciences required (Master’s or MBA preferred).
Agile Team Builder: Proven capability to attract, mentor, and scale high-performing, globally distributed PLM teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Performance Measures

Revenue Targets: Achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets to keep the business unit on its trajectory toward tripling the revenue in FY27.
Gross Margin Expansion: Driving product gross margins upward through pricing discipline, higher-value product mix (e.g., shifting toward 800G/1.6T coherent pluggables), and BOM (Bill of Materials) cost-down initiatives.
Hyperscale & Tier-1 Design Wins: Securing architectural design-ins and qualification milestones at top-tier cloud, AI cluster, and telecom customers.
Customer Concentration & Diversification: Expanding wallet share within anchor hyperscale accounts while onboarding new Tier-1/Tier-2 customers to ensure customer diversification.
Market Share Gains: Tracking revenue share growth against key optical interconnect competitors across target segments (e.g., DCI, intra-data center, metro coherent).
Forecast Accuracy: Minimizing excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory write-offs while preventing supply shortages during high-volume optical component ramps.
Talent & Retention: Recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent creating a high-performing organization.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintaining strong execution cadence across R&D, Sales, Services and Operations, measured via internal executive feedback and smooth deal-desk escalations.

Pay Range:
The annual salary range for this position in Canada is $292,700 - $467,500 CAD.

The annual salary range for this position in the US (including California) is $309,900 - $495,100 USD.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A
jobs.description:
At Range Group
we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. All our investments stem from a common thesis, that travel advisors add real value to a trip. Travel advisors when equipped with technology and 24/7 support are irreplaceable. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

About The Role

This is a hands-on senior finance leadership role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You’re as comfortable building a complex multi-entity model from scratch as you are presenting the story behind the numbers to the executive team.

As Director, FP&A, you will own the analytical engine that supports decision-making across Range Group’s portfolio of travel brands — leading enterprise planning and forecasting, managing a small team, and working directly with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, navigate risks, and drive performance.

What You’ll Do

Financial Modelling & Planning

Build, maintain, and continuously improve financial models covering consolidated Group performance, brand-level P&Ls, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Own the Group-level cash flow tracker and EBITDA bridging model, ensuring accuracy and timeliness week over week.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.
Support ad hoc financial analysis — acquisition modelling, business case development, and covenant compliance.
Drive continuous improvement in financial planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and analytical tools.

Performance Management & Executive Insights

Own enterprise-wide performance reporting — financial reviews, KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, and variance commentary.
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.
Translate financial results into clear, decision-ready insights that prompt action.
Identify and proactively flag emerging risks, opportunities, and performance trends across the portfolio.

Strategic Business Partnership

Partner with executive and business leaders to align financial plans with strategic priorities and growth objectives.
Evaluate investments, business initiatives, and strategic opportunities through modelling and scenario analysis.
Provide financial leadership on strategic initiatives, business cases, and investment decisions.
Support executive and Board reporting requirements.

Treasury & Foreign Exchange Management

Own foreign exchange exposure tracking, reporting, and scenario analysis across the Group's multi-currency operations.
Partner with treasury, banking partners, and external advisors to evaluate foreign exchange risks and mitigation strategies.
Assess the financial impact of currency fluctuations on forecasts, budgets, cash flow, and business performance.
Develop recommendations and decision-support materials for leadership regarding FX risk management and capital planning.
Monitor market trends and currency movements, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead a small finance team — including a Finance Manager and intern — as a player-coach: owning models and analysis end-to-end while delegating and developing where appropriate.
Foster a high-performance, analytically rigorous culture within the team.
Support ERP and reporting tool improvements from a finance data and output perspective.
Champion the evolution of finance from a reporting function to a true strategic business partner.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or Finance Business Partnering — with a track record of owning complex models in a multi-entity environment.
Advanced Excel skills — non-negotiable. You build models from scratch, structure them for auditability, and are fast and precise in the tool.
Strong accounting foundation: you understand how the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect inside a model.
Proven experience leading enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
Experience analyzing foreign exchange exposure, multi-currency financial impacts, and scenario modelling within a corporate FP&A, finance, or strategic finance environment.
Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and capable of influencing and constructively challenging stakeholders.
Experience in multi-entity and multi-currency operating environments.
CPA designation strongly preferred; candidates without the designation will be considered where technical skills and experience are strong.
Background in travel, technology, hospitality, or another fast-paced, multi-brand environment is an asset.

Who You Are

You are a builder. You prefer to own models end-to-end and take pride in work that is structured, auditable, and built to last.
You are intellectually curious and detail-oriented, but able to zoom out and connect the numbers to a broader business narrative.
You operate well with ambiguity and can manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or composure.
You are a collaborative leader who still wants to be close to the work — energized by doing, not just directing.
You communicate with a low-ego, peer-level style — credible with senior stakeholders, collegial with the broader team, and proactive about surfacing issues.

Why Join Range Group

This is a rare opportunity to bridge corporate finance and executive strategy in a multi-brand travel and technology portfolio. You’ll have genuine influence — shaping how capital is allocated, how performance is communicated, and how the finance function evolves as the company grows.

The role carries real complexity: multi-entity consolidations, multi-currency exposure, and a direct reporting line to the Chief Finance Officer. You’ll lead a small team and have the space to build the frameworks and processes that become the foundation for the company’s next phase.

Hybrid Work Model

We’re based in Toronto and targeting three days in office per week, with flexibility built in.

We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training.

jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

BDO Canada is seeking an accomplished Enterprise Managed Services Leader to help lead the next phase of growth for its Managed Services business. Working alongside the existing Managed Services leadership team, this role will be responsible for establishing and scaling BDO's enterprise managed services capabilities, enabling the firm to win, deliver, and grow complex enterprise client relationships.

This leader will combine business development, operational leadership, and client executive engagement to build a differentiated enterprise managed services practice. The role is accountable for leading enterprise pursuits, overseeing strategic client portfolios, developing scalable service offerings, maturing delivery capabilities, building high-performing teams, and driving profitable growth. Equally important, the successful candidate will help transform the practice from a transactional delivery organization into one focused on long-term client outcomes, innovation, and strategic partnerships.

BDO has built a successful and growing Managed Services business with a strong reputation for delivering technology and business application managed services to small and mid-market organizations. As part of the firm's long-term growth strategy, the practice is entering its next phase of evolution—expanding its enterprise capabilities, maturing its operating model, and scaling the business to meet increasing market demand.

Enterprise clients increasingly expect more than traditional support services. They are looking for strategic partners who can deliver measurable business outcomes through modern operating models, executive governance, automation, AI-enabled operations, continuous innovation, and integrated advisory capabilities. To remain competitive and differentiate in the market, BDO is evolving its Managed Services business beyond traditional service delivery toward intelligent, outcome-driven operations powered by automation, data, and Artificial Intelligence.

Meeting these expectations requires BDO to strengthen its enterprise delivery capabilities, develop scalable service offerings, mature its governance and operational excellence, and transform how services are delivered, managed, and continuously improved.

To support this evolution, BDO is seeking an experienced Enterprise Managed Services Leader who will complement the firm's existing Managed Services leadership by focusing on enterprise growth, operational maturity, and the future of AI-enabled managed services. This individual will play a critical leadership role in expanding BDO's enterprise market presence while helping transform the practice into a scalable, outcome-focused business capable of delivering intelligent operations at scale.

The successful candidate will help shape the future of the practice by:

Growing BDO's enterprise managed services business through strategic pursuits, executive client relationships, and long-term account development.
Building enterprise-grade service offerings, delivery models, governance frameworks, and quality standards that enable consistent, scalable delivery.
Driving the evolution of BDO's managed services business toward AI-enabled operations by embedding automation, observability, predictive analytics, AI, and continuous service optimization into service delivery.
Developing high-performing teams and leadership capabilities while fostering a culture focused on accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and client outcomes.
Strengthening collaboration across BDO's Advisory practice to deliver integrated business solutions and unlock new growth opportunities across service lines.

Key Responsibilities

Practice Leadership & Operating Model

Develop and execute the strategic vision for BDO's Enterprise Managed Services business, aligning with the firm's long-term growth objectives.
Build and continuously evolve an enterprise-grade managed services operating model that supports scalable, profitable, and consistent delivery.
Develop differentiated managed service offerings that address evolving client needs while incorporating AI-enabled operations, automation, and continuous innovation.
Establish standardized delivery methodologies, governance frameworks, quality standards, and service management processes that enable growth at scale.
Drive operational maturity through continuous improvement, process optimization, tooling, and best practices.
Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to ensure BDO remains an innovative and differentiated managed services provider.
Partner with practice leadership to establish strategic priorities, investment plans, and business performance objectives.

Enterprise Client Leadership

Serve as the executive sponsor for BDO's strategic enterprise managed services clients, building trusted relationships with executive stakeholders.
Provide executive oversight across the enterprise portfolio, ensuring delivery aligns with client business outcomes, contractual commitments, and long-term strategic objectives.
Lead executive governance, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and strategic planning sessions with clients.
Develop long-term account strategies that increase customer value, strengthen executive relationships, and expand BDO's footprint within enterprise organizations.
Transform customer engagements from transactional service delivery to strategic partnerships focused on measurable business outcomes and continuous value realization.
Act as an executive escalation point for complex delivery, commercial, and client relationship matters.

Business Development & Market Growth

Lead enterprise pursuits from qualification through contract execution, including solution strategy, commercial positioning, executive presentations, and proposal development.
Develop enterprise managed services offerings, commercial models, and value propositions that differentiate BDO in the marketplace.
Collaborate with Partners and leaders across Advisory to identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and bring integrated BDO capabilities to market.
Build strategic relationships with alliance partners and technology vendors to strengthen BDO's enterprise managed services offerings.
Identify emerging market opportunities and industry trends that inform service development and go-to-market strategies.
Contribute to annual business planning, growth strategies, forecasting, and pipeline development.

Delivery Excellence & Governance

Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across the enterprise managed services portfolio through disciplined governance and operational oversight.
Establish performance management frameworks utilizing KPIs, SLAs, XLAs, operational metrics, customer health indicators, and financial performance measures.
Drive service quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, utilization, and operational efficiency across the enterprise portfolio.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, AI-enabled service delivery, operational efficiency, and service innovation.
Build enterprise delivery capabilities that leverage modern IT Service Management (ITSM), AI Operations (AIOps), observability, and intelligent automation practices.
Ensure effective risk management, compliance, service continuity, and operational resilience across enterprise engagements.
Drive financial performance by managing portfolio profitability, forecasting, resource utilization, and delivery efficiency.

Team & Capability Building

Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing leaders and practitioners capable of supporting enterprise managed services clients.
Build leadership capability across delivery, customer success, solution architecture, service management, and operations.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, operational excellence, and client-centricity.
Establish career development frameworks, mentoring programs, succession planning, and capability-building initiatives.
Promote knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adoption of emerging technologies, AI, automation, and modern delivery practices.
Collaborate across BDO's Advisory practice to strengthen enterprise capabilities, share expertise, and develop integrated solutions for clients.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Job Description

Introduction:

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.

The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.

Summary:

Leads the end-to-end delivery of large-scale, complex initiatives, from strategic definition and planning through to hands-on tactical execution and successful implementation.
Serves as a key partner to senior business and functional leaders, building cross-functional alignment and acting as the primary point of contact for stakeholders up to the Managing Director level.
Manages high-visibility programs critical to firm-wide strategy, navigating varying levels of complexity to deliver measurable business value with executive-level sponsorship.
Drives transformational change by deploying advanced process improvement and operating model design methodologies, while also developing new approaches and building change capabilities across the organization.
Accountable for program success, measured by the tangible business value delivered, positive stakeholder feedback, and contributions to the firm's thought leadership.

Responsibilities:

Deliver high-impact operating model and process transformation projects by identifying business needs, validating pain points, and developing the business case for change.
Establish and execute robust program governance aligned with enterprise standards, developing detailed project plans, backlogs, and user stories to guide execution.
Lead the scoping, design, and execution of target operating model and process transformation initiatives; partner with senior business, operations, and functional leadership to establish business cases, strategic roadmaps, and business requirements for complex programs.
Partner with business and Technology to oversee and guide technical delivery, aligning solutions to target operating models, business requirements, and operational priorities throughout the project lifecycle.
Drive accountability and engagement by holding project teams responsible for deliverables and performance, while providing critical review and challenge to status reporting to highlight and mitigate risk.
Act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders and stakeholders, building strong relationships to ensure alignment, articulate complex recommendations, and manage expectations.
Leverage a range of methodologies including Agile, Lean, and Six Sigma to devise innovative solutions, streamline processes, and design future-state operating models.
Manage, mentor, and coach team members to elicit their best performance, partnering with leadership to build skills and identify high-performing individuals.
Champion a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability by reducing time-to-market, boosting quality, and capturing lessons learned to benefit the wider organization.
Proactively identify and manage program risks by simplifying processes, eliminating redundancies, and anticipating necessary changes to business systems and tools.

Qualifications:

A minimum of 14 years of experience managing complex, end-to-end programs and process transformation projects, with required experience in management consulting and within the financial services industry.
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required.
Experience advising and leading operating model and process transformation programs within financial services, owning the development of business requirements, analytical frameworks, and project delivery reporting up to senior management sponsorship
Demonstrated experience working with Technology teams to oversee delivery activities, support requirements implementation, helping achieve business objectives across delivery methodologies including Agile, Waterfall
Proven expertise in a range of methodologies including Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, and structured PM frameworks; PMP or PRINCE2 certification is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor program managers on high-risk, cross-functional initiatives, driving accountability and ensuring alignment with broader firm-wide strategy.

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

BDO Canada is seeking an accomplished Enterprise Managed Services Leader to help lead the next phase of growth for its Managed Services business. Working alongside the existing Managed Services leadership team, this role will be responsible for establishing and scaling BDO's enterprise managed services capabilities, enabling the firm to win, deliver, and grow complex enterprise client relationships.

This leader will combine business development, operational leadership, and client executive engagement to build a differentiated enterprise managed services practice. The role is accountable for leading enterprise pursuits, overseeing strategic client portfolios, developing scalable service offerings, maturing delivery capabilities, building high-performing teams, and driving profitable growth. BDO has built a successful and growing Managed Services business with a strong reputation for delivering technology and business application managed services to small and mid-market organizations. As part of the firm's long-term growth strategy, the practice is entering its next phase of evolution—expanding its enterprise capabilities, maturing its operating model, and scaling the business to meet increasing market demand.

Enterprise clients increasingly expect more than traditional support services. They are looking for strategic partners who can deliver measurable business outcomes through modern operating models, executive governance, automation, AI-enabled operations, continuous innovation, and integrated advisory capabilities. To remain competitive and differentiate in the market, BDO is evolving its Managed Services business beyond traditional service delivery toward intelligent, outcome-driven operations powered by automation, data, and Artificial Intelligence.

Meeting these expectations requires BDO to strengthen its enterprise delivery capabilities, develop scalable service offerings, mature its governance and operational excellence, and transform how services are delivered, managed, and continuously improved.

To support this evolution, BDO is seeking an experienced Enterprise Managed Services Leader who will complement the firm's existing Managed Services leadership by focusing on enterprise growth, operational maturity, and the future of AI-enabled managed services. This individual will play a critical leadership role in expanding BDO's enterprise market presence while helping transform the practice into a scalable, outcome-focused business capable of delivering intelligent operations at scale.

The successful candidate will help shape the future of the practice by:

Growing BDO's enterprise managed services business through strategic pursuits, executive client relationships, and long-term account development.
Building enterprise-grade service offerings, delivery models, governance frameworks, and quality standards that enable consistent, scalable delivery.
Driving the evolution of BDO's managed services business toward AI-enabled operations by embedding automation, observability, predictive analytics, AI, and continuous service optimization into service delivery.
Developing high-performing teams and leadership capabilities while fostering a culture focused on accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and client outcomes.
Strengthening collaboration across BDO's Advisory practice to deliver integrated business solutions and unlock new growth opportunities across service lines.

Practice Leadership & Operating Model

Develop and execute the strategic vision for BDO's Enterprise Managed Services business, aligning with the firm's long-term growth objectives.
Build and continuously evolve an enterprise-grade managed services operating model that supports scalable, profitable, and consistent delivery.
Develop differentiated managed service offerings that address evolving client needs while incorporating AI-enabled operations, automation, and continuous innovation.
Establish standardized delivery methodologies, governance frameworks, quality standards, and service management processes that enable growth at scale.
Drive operational maturity through continuous improvement, process optimization, tooling, and best practices.
Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to ensure BDO remains an innovative and differentiated managed services provider.
Partner with practice leadership to establish strategic priorities, investment plans, and business performance objectives.

Enterprise Client Leadership

Serve as the executive sponsor for BDO's strategic enterprise managed services clients, building trusted relationships with executive stakeholders.
Provide executive oversight across the enterprise portfolio, ensuring delivery aligns with client business outcomes, contractual commitments, and long-term strategic objectives.
Lead executive governance, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and strategic planning sessions with clients.
Develop long-term account strategies that increase customer value, strengthen executive relationships, and expand BDO's footprint within enterprise organizations.
Transform customer engagements from transactional service delivery to strategic partnerships focused on measurable business outcomes and continuous value realization.
Act as an executive escalation point for complex delivery, commercial, and client relationship matters.

Business Development & Market Growth

Lead enterprise pursuits from qualification through contract execution, including solution strategy, commercial positioning, executive presentations, and proposal development.
Develop enterprise managed services offerings, commercial models, and value propositions that differentiate BDO in the marketplace.
Collaborate with Partners and leaders across Advisory to identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and bring integrated BDO capabilities to market.
Build strategic relationships with alliance partners and technology vendors to strengthen BDO's enterprise managed services offerings.
Identify emerging market opportunities and industry trends that inform service development and go-to-market strategies.
Contribute to annual business planning, growth strategies, forecasting, and pipeline development.

Delivery Excellence & Governance

Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across the enterprise managed services portfolio through disciplined governance and operational oversight.
Establish performance management frameworks utilizing KPIs, SLAs, XLAs, operational metrics, customer health indicators, and financial performance measures.
Drive service quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, utilization, and operational efficiency across the enterprise portfolio.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, AI-enabled service delivery, operational efficiency, and service innovation.
Build enterprise delivery capabilities that leverage modern IT Service Management (ITSM), AI Operations (AIOps), observability, and intelligent automation practices.
Ensure effective risk management, compliance, service continuity, and operational resilience across enterprise engagements.
Drive financial performance by managing portfolio profitability, forecasting, resource utilization, and delivery efficiency.

Team & Capability Building

Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing leaders and practitioners capable of supporting enterprise managed services clients.
Build leadership capability across delivery, customer success, solution architecture, service management, and operations.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, operational excellence, and client-centricity.
Establish career development frameworks, mentoring programs, succession planning, and capability-building initiatives.
Promote knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adoption of emerging technologies, AI, automation, and modern delivery practices.
Collaborate across BDO's Advisory practice to strengthen enterprise capabilities, share expertise, and develop integrated solutions for clients.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.
